title: MARS: Multi-Specialist LLM Relay System for Competitive Programming
abstract: arXiv:2608.23918v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models excel at code generation, yet competitive programming exposes a persistent failure mode: existing multi-agent pipelines distribute work over generic planner, coder, and debugger roles and delegate the choice of algorithmic technique to the backbone alone. We present MARS (Multi-Agent Relay of Specialized LLMs), a prompt-only framework in which each agent is a topic specialist---dynamic programming, graphs, strings, geometry, and so on---grounded by retrieval-augmented generation over an algorithm-theory corpus. Given a problem, retrieval selects a small team of relevant specialists; a starter writes an initial C++17 solution, and each subsequent turn runs the candidate against public examples in a sandbox, lets the active specialist keep, repair, or hand off the draft, and forwards a structured packet to the next specialist. translated_title: MARS：面向竞技编程的多专家大语言模型中继系统
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型在代码生成方面表现出色，但竞技编程暴露了一个持续存在的失败模式：现有的多智能体流水线将工作分配给通用的规划者、编码者和调试者角色，并将算法技术选择的任务完全交给骨干模型。我们提出了MARS（专业大语言模型的多智能体中继系统），这是一个仅基于提示的框架，其中每个智能体都是特定主题的专家——如动态规划、图论、字符串、几何等——并通过检索增强生成技术，基于算法理论语料库进行支撑。给定一个问题，检索模块会选择一小队相关的专家；一个启动者编写初始的C++17解决方案，随后每一轮都会在沙箱中针对公开示例运行候选方案，让当前活跃的专家保留、修复或移交草稿，并将结构化信息包转发给下一个专家。最后，一个单一的基础设施修复过程会规范化样板代码。在CodeContests测试集上，该系统展现了显著的优势。
tldr: 本文提出MARS框架，通过将多个专业大语言模型智能体按算法主题分工，并结合检索增强生成和沙箱测试，显著提升了竞技编程任务的解决能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MARS, a framework that assigns specialized LLM agents by algorithm topic, combined with retrieval-augmented generation and sandbox testing, to significantly improve competitive programming problem-solving.
